summary: W7 Phase 1 business acceptance repair handoff. Coding/Repair is authorized only to repair the DT-18/TS-08 production runtime loopholes where missing actual benchmark observations can fabricate perfect quality evidence and whole delivery can accept aggregatePrecision outside [0,1]. Whole delivery remains allowed only after W2-W6 are accepted and DT-18 proves 100% key seed recall from actual observations, 100% closure correctness from actual observations, zero forced unrelated hits, and recorded precision inside [0,1].

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the approved five-purpose business benchmark after W2-W6 acceptance evidence is available, then run negative benchmark counterexamples for missing observations, empty/incomplete content, and out-of-range precision.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Every purpose reports mandatory key seed ids, actual recalled key seed ids, no missing key seeds, expected closure correctness from actual observed closure ids, zero forced hits for unrelated controls, recorded precision inside [0,1], aggregate recall 1, aggregate closure correctness 1, and no invented release precision threshold. Missing actual recall observations, missing actual closure observations, empty benchmarks, incomplete benchmarks, and precision outside [0,1] must block instead of synthesizing perfect evidence.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Attempt W7 or whole delivery with incomplete W2-W6 evidence, with W2-W6 accepted but DT-18 missing or failing, with W2-W6 accepted and aggregatePrecision outside [0,1] including -99, and with a fully passing ordered control case.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The delivery gate blocks incomplete prerequisites, blocks whole delivery until W7 DT-18 passes, rejects invalid aggregate precision outside [0,1], and allows delivery only after W2-W6 plus W7 business benchmark evidence pass.

criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The handoff authorizes only DT-18 and TS-08 delivery-sequence scope, keeps DT-19 capacity evidence out of Coding scope, and preserves runner-owned deliveryStatus authority.

tasks.title: Evaluate phase-one quality benchmark
tasks.objective: Make DT-18 quality evidence honest for the approved five-purpose benchmark.
steps: Keep evaluatePhase1QualityBenchmark(request) on createProductionGraphRagRuntime's returned public boundary.
Consume the Harness-provided benchmark purposes without inventing a precision release threshold, result cap, or observation fallback.
Reject missing actual recalledKeySeedIds and missing actual observedClosureIds instead of falling back to mandatoryKeySeedIds or expectedClosureIds.
Reject empty benchmarks, incomplete five-purpose benchmark content, and per-purpose precision outside [0,1].
Return qualityEvidence.benchmarkId, purposes, perPurpose observations, keySeedRecall 1, closureCorrectness 1, unrelatedForcedHits 0, aggregatePrecision, and undefined releasePrecisionThreshold.
tasks.completionSignal: runRetrievalQualityBenchmark.js exits 0 and DT-18 records 100% recall, 100% closure correctness, zero forced unrelated hits, in-range precision evidence, and blocking failures for fabricated/missing observations, empty/incomplete benchmarks, and out-of-range precision.

tasks.title: Gate whole delivery sequence
tasks.objective: Block W7 and whole delivery until prerequisites and in-range DT-18 quality evidence pass.
steps: Keep evaluateDeliverySequence(request) on the production runtime public boundary.
For incomplete prerequisites, return blocked with category DELIVERY_PREREQUISITES_INCOMPLETE and exact missing waves from W2 through W6.
For whole-delivery attempts with missing, failed, incomplete, or out-of-range qualityBenchmark evidence, return blocked with category W7_QUALITY_BENCHMARK_REQUIRED.
Reject aggregatePrecision outside [0,1], including -99, as non-passing W7 quality evidence.
For W2-W6 accepted plus passed DT-18 evidence, return status allowed and releaseAllowed true.
tasks.completionSignal: runSevenWaveDeliveryGates.js exits 0 with prerequisite blocking, W7-quality blocking, aggregate-precision range blocking, and ordered delivery allowance proven.
